name: [🌴] Moo Moo Mystery 🐄
desc:
Can you solve the murder-moo-moo mystery and survive each round?

🐄 COW: Murder everyone! Don't get shot by security.
🙍‍♂️ RESEARCHER: Run and hide from the cow, and try to expose their identity.
👮‍♂️ SECURITY: Protect the researchers by eliminating the cow.

You're stranded in space alongside your team of researchers..
But you're not alone. 
Someone or some.. thing is out there with you.
 
Collect countless unique items!
